{{Short description|Stream cipher}}
{{third-party |date=April 2024}}
In [[cryptography]], '''CryptMT''' is a [[stream cipher]] [[algorithm]] which internally uses the [[Mersenne twister]]. It was developed by [[Makoto Matsumoto (mathematician)|Makoto Matsumoto]], [[Mariko Hagita]], [[Takuji Nishimura]] and [[Mutsuo Saito]] and is [[patent]]ed. It was one of the final Phase 3 candidates<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ecrypt.eu.org/stream/phase3list.html |title=eSTREAM Phase 3 Candidates |website=The eSTREAM Project |publisher=ECRYPT |access-date=2024-06-11}}</ref> in the [[eSTREAM]] project of the [[eCRYPT]] network but was not selected because [[Stream cipher#Filter generator|the non-linear filter]] component was not as well-understood in terms of its security.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.ecrypt.eu.org/stream/portfolio.pdf |title=eThe eSTREAM Portfolio |website=The eSTREAM Project |publisher=ECRYPT |access-date=2024-06-11}}</ref> 

In that submission to [[eSTREAM]], the authors also included another cipher named '''Fubuki''', which also uses the Mersenne twister.
